'''DAC Nádorváros 1912''' is a Hungarian [[association football|football]] club based in [[Győr]]. The club, known as ''Integrál-DAC'' at the time, was declared bankrupt in 2009, but was re-founded as DAC Nádorváros.<ref>[https://adatbank.mlsz.hu/club/63/8/29326/17/288951.html DAC NÁDORVÁROS]. adatbank.mlsz.hu</ref>"}}
